The '''Cheese Press''' is a type of [[Crafting#Artisan Equipment|Artisan Equipment]] used to make [[Artisan Goods]]. It takes [[Milk]] and turns it into [[Cheese]]. 

Regular quality [[Milk]] produces regular quality [[Cheese]], and regular quality [[Goat Milk]] produces regular quality [[Goat Cheese]]. [[Large Milk]] and [[Large Goat Milk]] produce gold quality cheeses. Cheese and Goat Cheese can be aged in [[Cask]]s to increase their value.

A Cheese Press is the reward for completing the {{Bundle|Animal||y}}.
